lines.text: Many learners say: Thank you for come.

native.tip: Kita bilang “terima kasih sudah datang”, tapi setelah for bahasa Inggris pakai kata kerja + ing: for coming.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “Thank you for come.” 😅 Setelah for, kata kerja + ing: “Thank you for coming.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “coming”. Tulis satu kalimat terima kasih untuk temanmu dengan Thank you for … ing. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “terima kasih sudah datang”, but after for English uses the verb + ing: for coming.
en.caption: Ever say this? “Thank you for come.” 😅 After for, verb + ing: “Thank you for coming.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
